**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Bind region hashes to the evidence manifest**

When a frozen source row contains the expected pages but a `regions[*].crop_sha256` differs from the hashed evidence manifest or packet image while remaining valid lowercase hex, this gate still passes: it checks only page alignment and hash syntax, while `validate_packets()` validates the packet evidence independently without comparing it to these source-region tuples. The resulting reconciliation can therefore certify an authoritative chain derived from evidence that is not actually bound to the source row; compare the page/hash tuples against the referenced manifest or packet chain before accepting it.

body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Activate the repaired freeze before running the maker**

After `repair-navigation-gate` publishes `pre-provider-freeze.v2.json`, a subsequent invocation of this script's `run-maker` command still selects v1 because this default is never changed by the repair and there is no committed runner override. On the affected batch, the supposedly invalidated predecessor is therefore the only freeze consulted—typically causing dependency verification to stop on the old script hash rather than allowing work from the newly bound v2—so the repair cannot actually unblock production without an out-of-band mutation of this module global.
